source: Sabarish et al. 2025, A&A 703 A142, arXiv:2505.14779
extraction: Black five-point vector markers transformed with the figure's affine axis coordinates
scope: Constant isotropic cross-section, isolated conductive SIDM spike
printed_C_consistency_note: The printed C value is incompatible with the plotted fit and the paper's stated 1.7 Msun/yr collisionless baseline. The calibration therefore refits C, A, and B jointly to the vector data.
warning: This benchmark is not a t-channel Yukawa or Bondi-inflow calibration.
